ValidationRule.description: Block user from updating the College Stage from "Applied" & College Status from "New" until the WPC Graduate Application is not owned by an API user.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Id <> '00ed00000017Iob', Owner.FirstName = "API", RecordType.Name = "Graduate Application", College__r.Name = "W. P. Carey School of Business", ISPICKVAL(College_Stage__c, "Applied"), ISCHANGED(College_Status__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(College_Status__c, "New")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot update the College Stage from "Applied" and the College Status from "New" until the Opportunity Owner is not an API user.
